name: Deep Sea
blurb: A bioluminescent abyss: an anglerfish's lantern, a siphonophore's chain of light, a little submersible's headlamp and a squid that talks in flashes.

games.label: Lure
games.hint: Glow as each little one touches the lantern

games.label: Chain
games.hint: Tap as the light reaches the new bell

games.label: Lamp
games.hint: Snap as the headlamp finds each creature

games.label: Echo
games.hint: Flash back as the far squid's light reaches you
